bibl.title: Gaias Rechtsstreit und Caracallas Alexandria-Aufenthalt. Zum Kontext des Privatbriefs P.Oxy. 43/3094.
bibl.seg: Patrick Reinard, Gaias Rechtsstreit und Caracallas Alexandria-Aufenthalt. Zum Kontext des Privatbriefs P.Oxy. 43/3094.
bibl.note: The lawsuit discussed in the private letter P. Oxy. XLIII, 3094 was carried on before three governors: a detailed reconstruction is made possible by a chronological reconciliation with the events and implications of Caracalla's journey to Alexandria in the winter of 215/16 AD.
